text.tspan: Current implementation · Docker Compose / OrbStack · Repeated icons refer to the same service.
Each member consulted once per turn
One sandbox connection per batch · Serialized actions · Stop on failure; completed actions are not rolled back
Browser connects through desktop relay; API key stays server-side
Lifecycle: pause after 5 min without a new tool/desktop connection; checked every minute.
Expiry: 24 h after last connection; memory deleted on expiry/deletion. Optional Sentry; Trigger runs in Docker.
